_about: Text normalization shared by every town in config/towns/ and by the danger filter. Town vocabularies live in config/towns/<id>.json.

normalization._note: Applied to message text BEFORE cyrillic matching. Latin matching runs on the cleaned text (stress marks/invisible chars stripped, whitespace collapsed, no folding or lowercasing), because folding latin->cyrillic would destroy 'Vinnytsia'.

referencePoint._about: Phrases that use a town only as a LANDMARK: «східніше Вінниці» means somewhere east of the city, not the city. A town mention directly after one of these does not count. If the town is named nowhere else, the post is dropped (shadow-logged as reference-point). «повз Вінницю» is deliberately NOT here — passing the city is a threat to it.
referencePoint._syntax: Regex fragments, lowercase, matched on normalized text immediately before the town form. Optional «м.»/«міста»/«г.»/«города» between phrase and town is handled in code.
